                       one workspace. truthful lifecycle.

Rungrid compiles a portable .rungrid.yaml into one observable local
development workspace. Process Compose owns managed-service lifecycle while
Warp or a headless shell provides the operator surface.

🔁 Workspace Lifecycle (single managed-service authority):
  .rungrid.yaml → portable workspace authority
    │
    ▼
  plan / generate → deterministic preview and derived state
    │
    ▼
  rungrid up
    ├─ lifecycle.before_up → ordered prerequisites
    └─ Process Compose → lifecycle and logs
         ├─ Overview → read-only TUI and selectable logs
         ├─ Versions → process, ports, and Git state
         ├─ Service tabs → exclusive tab-owned sessions
         └─ Maintenance jobs → CLI-authorized sync and prune logs
    │
    ▼
  rungrid down → lifecycle.after_down → ordered teardown

🧩 Service Ownership
  workspace  starts with rungrid up
  tab        belongs to one foreground session
  external   is observed and never managed

Usage
  rungrid [command]

Available Commands

Configure
  init           Create a portable workspace manifest
  instructions   Print coding-agent workspace wiring instructions (alias: agent-start)
  doctor         Validate configuration and local dependencies
  config         Inspect and validate manifest configuration

Build & Launch
  plan           Show deterministic generation and lifecycle actions
  generate       Generate owned project runtime artifacts
  up             Generate and start the detached workspace
  open           Open the Warp workspace or one service tab

Observe
  attach         Attach to the active Process Compose TUI
  versions       Show process, listener, and source-control state
  status         Report active runtime and service state
  logs           Read Process Compose service logs

Maintain
  sync           Fast-forward configured repositories' default branches
  reconcile      Safely reconcile a repository or recursive repository tree
  worktrees      Inspect and safely maintain linked Git worktrees

Control
  session        Own a tab service until stop or signal
  start          Start a service using activation-aware behavior
  stop           Stop an exact managed service
  down           Perform ordered workspace shutdown

Cleanup & Utilities
  uninstall      Remove only owned project state and Warp files
  completion     Generate shell completion
  version        Show build and API compatibility
  help           Help about any command


Flags
      --config string      manifest path (default ".rungrid.yaml")
  -h, --help               help for rungrid
      --json               emit rungrid/output/v1 JSON
      --local string       local overlay path
      --no-color           disable ANSI color
      --project string     select a known project id
  -q, --quiet              suppress non-error output
      --state-dir string   state root override
  -v, --verbose            include redacted diagnostics

Use "rungrid [command] --help" for more information about a command.
